[[Mallyx's Longbow]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[bow]] obtained from the [[Citadel Chest]] that spawns after defeating [[Mallyx the Unyielding]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[The Ebony Citadel of Mallyx]].

==Stats==
:[[Piercing damage]]: 15-28 (Requires 9 [[Marksmanship]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:[[Life Draining]]: 5
:[[Health regeneration]] -1
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Grinning Recurve Bow]].

*[[Ironwing Longbow]] has stats identical to this item.
*[[Guidance]], [[Deldrimor Hornbow (unique)]],  [[Forgotten Hornbow]], [[Vah's Hornbow]], [[Elswyth's Recurve Bow]], and [[Tundoss' Shortbow]] have stats identical to this item; however, they are different classes.
